title: Interior Design
description: Make the Details Matter. From materials and lighting to joinery and finishes, we'll help you make decisions that give your home its unique character.
seoDescription: Interior Design in Nairobi for private residences, apartments, villas, and carefully resolved living spaces.

process.title: Discovery & Interior Brief
process.copy: We begin by understanding lifestyle, routines, aspirations, furniture requirements, and project goals.

process.title: Concept & Spatial Planning
process.copy: Layouts, atmosphere, circulation, references, and design direction are established.

process.title: Design Development
process.copy: Materials, joinery, furniture planning, kitchens, bathrooms, and lighting are refined into a coordinated proposal.

process.title: Specification & Visualization
process.copy: Material palettes, schedules, joinery details, and visualizations communicate the design clearly.

process.title: Documentation & Procurement Support
process.copy: Detailed information is prepared for pricing, fabrication, purchasing, and installation.

process.title: Site Coordination
process.copy: We remain involved during implementation to support design quality and consistency.

fullDescription: For homeowners seeking interiors that feel cohesive, comfortable, and deeply connected to the architecture.
